t: Treatment Options for Allergy-Triggered Asthma
s: June 19, 2023 - Omalizumab (Xolair) is usually for people with severe asthma that doesn't go away and isn't controlled with other treatments. It prevents cells in your body from starting the inflammation process and makes you less sensitive to your triggers. It's given as an injection every 2 or 4 weeks at your doctor's office because you might have a severe allergic reaction to it.
